shots.narration_en: One model, one harness, one training review. Follow how the agent works inside Claude Code, and how its files are checked.
shots.caption_zh: 一个模型、一套 Harness、一次培训评估。看 Agent 如何在 Claude Code 里工作，交付物又如何被检验。

shots.narration_en: A fictional cold-chain operator trained supervisors at three sites for six weeks. A fourth site, trained later, is the comparison.
shots.caption_zh: 一家虚构的冷链运营商在三个中心对一线主管进行了六周训练；第四个中心延期参训，作为同期对照。

shots.narration_en: The agent must judge what the training changed, then decide acceptance and payment for three vendor work packages, worth 816,000 yuan.
shots.caption_zh: Agent 要判断训练带来了什么变化，再对三个服务采购工作包给出验收和付款建议，合计 816,000 元。

shots.narration_en: 17 files go in: rosters, attendance, tests, field observations, work orders and procurement rules. A workbook and a decision memo must come out.
shots.caption_zh: 输入 17 份材料：花名册、出勤、测验、现场观察、工单和采购规则；产出一份工作簿和一份决策备忘录。

shots.narration_en: The scoring rubric is not in the container. The agent works without seeing how it will be judged.
shots.caption_zh: 评分标准不在容器里。Agent 在看不到评判方式的情况下工作。

shots.narration_en: Claude Code runs the loop. The model chooses an action, Claude Code turns it into a tool call, the call runs inside the container, and the result returns to the model.
shots.caption_zh: Claude Code 负责运行循环：模型选择动作，Claude Code 把它变成工具调用，调用在容器里执行，结果再回到模型。

shots.narration_en: After listing the inputs, the second request sends eight tool calls at once, one preview per data ledger. All eight results come back together.
shots.caption_zh: 列出输入目录之后，第二次请求一次发出 8 个工具调用，逐个预览数据台账；8 个结果一起返回。

shots.narration_en: Request three writes a plan with TodoWrite: validate the samples, analyze learning and behavior, compare the sites, and compute the payments.
shots.caption_zh: 第三次请求用 TodoWrite 写下计划：核定样本、分析学习与行为、比较各中心，再计算付款。

shots.narration_en: Then it reads the workbooks and Word files. One rule matters: individual learning data may only be used for assessment, support and acceptance.
shots.caption_zh: 接着它读取工作簿和 Word 文件。其中一条规则很关键：个人学习数据只能用于项目评估、支持性辅导和采购验收。

shots.narration_en: Then comes one long response. For over two minutes the model writes a single analysis script, and Claude Code's Write tool saves it in the container.
shots.caption_zh: 接着是一次很长的响应：模型用了两分多钟写出一整个分析脚本，Claude Code 的 Write 工具把它保存进容器。

shots.narration_en: Bash runs the script. It loads every ledger and writes both files. Work package A comes out as accepted, yet 10% of its payment is held back.
shots.caption_zh: Bash 运行这个脚本，读入全部台账并写出两份文件。工作包 A 的结果是“验收通过”，却又扣留了 10% 的款项。

shots.narration_en: The run succeeded, with no error. But after reading its own output, the model reports problems in the WP-A status logic and the sample filter.
shots.caption_zh: 运行成功，没有报错。但读完自己的输出后，模型指出 WP-A 的状态判定和样本筛选存在问题。

shots.narration_en: It checks the scope: 81 people included, 2 observation-limited, 1 excluded. Then it reads the script, edits it four times, and runs it again.
shots.caption_zh: 它核对样本范围：81 人纳入、2 人观察受限、1 人排除。随后读取脚本、修改 4 处，再重新运行。

shots.narration_en: Same script, still no error. This time WP-A is a conditional acceptance: 220,320 yuan to approve, 24,480 retained.
shots.caption_zh: 同一个脚本，依旧没有报错。这次 WP-A 变为附条件验收：建议提交审批 220,320 元，保留 24,480 元。

shots.narration_en: It checks the nine-sheet workbook and the memo, and confirms that only the two required files are in the output folder.
shots.caption_zh: 它检查 9 张表的工作簿和备忘录，并确认输出目录里只有这两份文件。

shots.narration_en: The plan is ticked off and the agent stops: 28 requests, 44 tool calls, about six minutes. Not one tool call failed.
shots.caption_zh: 计划全部打勾，Agent 结束：28 次请求、44 次工具调用，约 6 分钟，没有一次工具调用失败。

shots.narration_en: Here is the whole run. 33 Bash, 4 TodoWrite, 1 Write, 2 Read and 4 Edit calls. The turning point was not a crash; it came from the model reading its own results.
shots.caption_zh: 这是整次运行：33 次 Bash、4 次 TodoWrite、1 次 Write、2 次 Read、4 次 Edit。转折点不是崩溃，而是模型读了自己的结果。

shots.narration_en: Each result is added to the model's context. By the last request, the prompt has grown from about 25 thousand to about 89 thousand tokens.
shots.caption_zh: 每个结果都会追加进模型的上下文。到最后一次请求，提示长度从约 2.5 万 token 增长到约 8.9 万。

shots.narration_en: When the agent stops, Harbor copies the tests into the same container. Only then does scoring begin.
shots.caption_zh: Agent 停止后，Harbor 才把测试复制进同一个容器。评分这时才开始。

shots.narration_en: An independent check now takes over.
shots.caption_zh: 接下来，由独立检验接手。

shots.narration_en: RewardKit opens one judge session for each of 34 criteria. The judge model is qwen3.7-plus, a different model from the agent. Nothing flows back to the agent.
shots.caption_zh: RewardKit 为 34 条评分项各开一个裁判会话；裁判模型是 qwen3.7-plus，与 Agent 所用模型不同。评分结果不会回传给 Agent。

shots.narration_en: The WP-A fix holds up: the judge accepts the conditional-acceptance status.
shots.caption_zh: WP-A 的修正经受住了检验：裁判认可“附条件验收”这一状态。

shots.narration_en: Other parts fall short. The workbook pools the three trained sites instead of comparing each one with the delayed site, and it has no source-index sheet.
shots.caption_zh: 其他部分没有过关：工作簿把三个受训中心合并计算，而不是逐一与延期中心比较；也没有“来源索引”表。

shots.narration_en: And one penalty applies. Ten people had too few chances to show the behavior, yet the workbook marks them as not meeting the standard.
shots.caption_zh: 还有一项扣分：10 人因机会不足无法评价，工作簿却把他们标为“行为不达标”。

shots.narration_en: Too little opportunity is not evidence of low ability, so seven weighted points are deducted.
shots.caption_zh: 机会不足不等于能力不足，因此扣除 7 个原始加权分。

shots.narration_en: Of 28 positive criteria, 6 are met and 22 are not. One of six penalties applies, and this task has no red-line criteria.
shots.caption_zh: 28 个正向评分项中 6 项满足、22 项未满足；6 个扣分项中触发 1 项；本题没有红线项。

shots.narration_en: The recorded reward is 0.208: 29 points, minus 7, over 106. One pilot run on a fictional task, not a ranking.
shots.caption_zh: 记录的奖励值为 0.208，即 (29 − 7) / 106。这是虚构任务上的一次试跑，不是排名。

shots.narration_en: A professional task, an agent run, and an independent check. Explore more on the InferenceNet Challenge site.
shots.caption_zh: 专业任务、Agent 运行、独立检验。更多内容见 InferenceNet Challenge 网站。

boundaries: Editorial replay of an existing recorded pilot run; no new agent run, no re-scoring.
Request numbers are the 28 assistant message ids of the Claude Code session log; tool steps are run-export indexes.
Claude Code and Bash run inside the task's Docker container; the model is reached through an API.
The rubric and tests are absent during the agent run; Harbor copies tests into the same container afterwards.
Judge sessions are separate per criterion; scores never feed back into the recorded agent run.
